version.changelog: Composio para buscar (Tavily y Apify) con comandos exactos en f100k-puente, actores con virgulilla y reglas de evidencia

llm.summary: This trend-alert skill is mostly purpose-aligned, but it has conflicting instructions about email versus Telegram and can read or derive local profile/config data without clear user control.

dimensions.detail: Reading cerebro/f100k-config.json is proportionate, but deriving config from USER.md and the broader cerebro/ directory plus checking APIFY_TOKEN is under-scoped for casual trend requests, especially because the skill also performs outbound searches and notifications.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: The artifact is a single Markdown skill file with no bundled executable scripts, dependencies, install hooks, or remote code retrieval found in the inspected package.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: The skill has contradictory control flow: the OpenClaw section says missing config should be created from USER.md and cerebro/ and confirmed by Telegram, while FASE 1 says to stop and tell the user to run another routine. It also says OpenClaw alerts must not send email, while FASE 5 instructs Gmail draft creation.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: No system persistence, services, scheduled tasks, or privilege escalation were found; the only persistent mutation described is possible creation of cerebro/f100k-config.json when missing.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

dimensions.detail: The stated purpose is coherent: detect emerging niche trends using TikTok, web/news search, and then generate an alert/script when a trend is strong enough.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

llm.guidance: Review before installing. This skill may read local F100K profile/config files, use an Apify token if present, run web/TikTok trend searches, and send alerts. Install only if you are comfortable with Telegram-only alerts being enforced and with the missing-config behavior being clarified so it does not infer settings from broader local files without your approval.
llm.findings:
[SDI-4] unexpected: Accepted in part: outbound alerts are expected, but the artifact materially conflicts between Telegram-only OpenClaw behavior and Gmail draft creation, creating unclear disclosure of the destination channel.
[SQP-1] expected: Downgraded but relevant: broad Spanish activation phrases are consistent with a convenience trend skill, yet they increase accidental invocation risk because the skill reads config, searches externally, and may alert.
[SDI-4] unexpected: Accepted: the missing-config behavior directly conflicts between creating config from USER.md/cerebro/ and stopping for another routine, so user control over local data derivation is ambiguous.
[SQP-2] expected: Accepted as a scoping concern rather than malicious behavior: local config and APIFY_TOKEN use fit the trend-detection purpose, but the artifact does not clearly require consent before reading or deriving from broader local profile data.
